name: ConvertX
description: A file converter with a web page: upload documents, images, audio, video, fonts or 3D models and get them back in another format, converted on this server by the tools bundled in the image.

access.note: ConvertX starts with no accounts: while none exists, the first visitor to the address can register one, and that account is the only one — registration stays closed afterwards (ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION is off). Register yourself right after deploying. Conversions run on this server, so a large upload costs it CPU and disk until the file is deleted from the page.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

secrets.name: jwt-secret
secrets.label: Session signing secret
secrets.description: Signs the sign-in tokens; changing it signs everybody out.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The page and its upload and conversion endpoints

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: The SQLite database of accounts and jobs, and uploaded and converted files until they are deleted

update.notes: ConvertX migrates its database on start; it is still before 1.0, so read the release notes.
